Following last Tuesday’s addition of Family Feud Pocket, Apple Arcade is expanding its catalog once again today with four more games spanning city-building, dungeon crawling, fishing, and quick-draw challenges. Here are the details.

Apple Arcade adds four new games

Earlier this week, Apple Arcade added Family Feud Pocket to its catalog of nearly 300 ad-free games. Now, as previously announced, the service has expanded its lineup once again with four more titles:

According to Apple, Creatures of the Deep+ is “a single-player fishing adventure that plunges players into a world of ancient secrets, legendary monsters, and mysterious treasures.” Rated 4+, the game is available on iPhone, iPad, iPod touch, and Apple Vision Pro.

Also available on iPhone, iPad, iPod touch, and Apple Vision Pro for players ages 9 and up, Dungeon Clawler+ “combines the strategic depth of a roguelike deckbuilder with the unpredictability of an arcade claw machine,“ according to Apple Arcade’s press release.

Like Creatures of the Deep+, Draw It+ is rated 4+. Apple says this new Apple Arcade game “challenges artists and doodlers alike to sketch clues from a wide variety of prompts and score points before time runs out.” It is available for iPhone, iPad, and iPod touch.

“A fun spin on the city-building genre, allowing players to construct a sprawling metropolis and then drop themselves in it,” Pocket City 2+ is rated 9 and up, and it is available for iPhone, iPad, iPod touch, Mac, Apple Vision Pro, and Apple TV.

Apple Arcade is available as a standalone service for $6.99/month or included in the Apple One bundle. It includes access to over 270 games with no ads or in-app purchases.
